newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar and stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar and stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both dollar and sterling on Thursday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a commercial mean rate of 20.7795 to the dollar from 20.707 on Wednesday and at 34.0505 to the sterling from 33.991.
"The central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Wednesday mid afternoon at the prevailing interbank rate," one dealer said.
The dealer added that leading banks were in square forex positions after the central bank's intervention on Wednesday.
